en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Abu Kahmasy who said,

‘I heard Abu Abdullahasws saying: ‘A man entered the Masjid, so he began (asking) before the laudation upon Allahazwj and the Blessings upon the Prophetsaww. So Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘The servant hastened with his Lordazwj’. Then another one entered, so he prayed Salāt and lauded upon Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic, and sent Blessings upon Rasool-Allahsaww. So Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘Ask, you would be Given’.

Then heasws said: ‘In the Book of Aliasws is the laudation upon Allahazwj and the Salāt upon Hisazwj Rasoolsaww before the asking, and if one of you goes over to the man seeking the need, so he would love it if you were to be saying to him good (words) before you ask him for the need’.
en.sarwar: 7. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Ali ibn al-Hakam from abu Kahmas who has said the following:

“I heard abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) saying, ‘Once a man came to the Mosque and he began without praising Allah and asking from Him favors for the Holy Prophet. The Messenger of Allah said, ‘The servant (of Allah) hastened his Lord.’ Then another man came in and prayed, praised Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, and asked favors from Him for the Messenger of Allah. The Messenger of Allah said, ‘Ask for help you will receive it.’

Thereafter the Imam said, ‘It is in the book of Ali (a.s.) “Praising Allah and asking favors from Him for the Messenger of Allah should come before asking for help. When anyone comes to a man to request a favor, he loves to say to him the best words to him before asking for help.’”
